title: LLMS LEFT, RIGHT, AND CENTER: ASSESSING GPT’S CAPABILITIES TO LABEL POLITICAL BIAS FROM WEB DOMAINS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing GPT-4's zero-shot political ideology classifications of news website URLs (on a 7-point scale from far-left to far-right) against human-annotated ratings from Media Bias/Fact Check (MBFC), and using a one-sample t-test to measure any systematic left-leaning skew in the model's predictions.

Using Open PageRank scores to quantify website popularity and running Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) and logistic regressions to evaluate how a domain's popularity impacts the model's classification accuracy and its likelihood of abstaining from assigning a rating.
